hooks.notes: Balance (game/scripts/balance-probe.mts): was +10. Waking at home softens the day (+3 against the dawn's -6), it no longer refills you on its own, so staying in the den doing nothing still runs the fire down.

Balance (game/scripts/balance-probe.mts): was +12, now -6. Each dawn asks something of you: with only the archetype's own small comfort (+3) idle play loses about 3 a day and burns out in three to four weeks. Spark comes back from real deeds (seeing people grow, working beside them), not from sleeping.
Balance (game/scripts/balance-probe.mts): was +10. A clean ledger is a comfort (+3), not a refill, so idle play stays net-negative.

Balance (game/scripts/balance-probe.mts): was +6. This is where kind play earns its spark back: at +3 four kind deeds a day hold the fire (mean ~83, rarely burns out); at +6 kindness paid more than it cost and spark never moved off full; at +2 kind play burned out within 20-90 days.
Balance (game/scripts/balance-probe.mts): was +12. Basking together is a comfort (+3), not a refill, so idle play stays net-negative.

Worked beside someone yesterday: the row was full again for a shift. Balance (game/scripts/balance-probe.mts): was +8; +6 still outweighs the dawn (-6) and the empty row (-1), so a Bren who works alongside holds steady.
